lines: A piercing roar of gunfire reverberated through the area.
Annreed's preemptive strike signaled the start of the battle.
The rotten body of a zombie blew away, and the bits of flesh scattered all over the place with a horrible sound.
Sorry, but you stinky losers don't get to come closer!
Annreed's quick draw was so fast that the sounds of gunfire overlapped, and several zombies blew away simultaneously.
Not bad! I don't want these stinky assholes anywhere near me either soー
Cold air charging in her fists, Kirara-senpai lunged at the pack of golems.
Let me deal with these guys!
One of the golems unleashed a kick with a swiftness that did not match its lumbering steel body.
But Kirara-senpai met it head-on with her ice claw without skipping a beat.
An ice statue beautifully frozen mid-kick had been created, which then shattered to pieces a moment later with a piercing clear sound.
And by then, she was already moving on to sculpt the next one.
Glittering, fine clouds of ice danced around Kirara-senpai as she freely unleashed her skills.
It was an intense battle, yet also a wondrous sight.
I thought you were just the Captain's fan, but you've got moves!
Even while looking aside, she didn't stop shooting and continued to take out one zombie after another while spinning her guns.
Of course! And just so you know, Fuma is my fan!
Kirara-senpai also didn't let up her offensive, freezing golems one after another as she answered.
Just what I'd expect from those two.
Although they were still somewhat butting heads over something, they seemed to have now recognized each other's strength at least.
Oh, I was not Kirara-senpai's fan, by the way.
No sooner had I heard that voice than...
Hebiko unleashed her Octopus Tentacle Four Blade Style, destroying not only the zombies but the steel golems as well in one swoop.
Hebiko's putting in a fair bit of work too. Looks like this will be an easy win, too.
Pride goeth before the fall. The guardian here will certainly be a formidable foe.
Just as before, I didn't need to give any commands. But when I looked over at Chevalier she wasn't reading her book like usual.
What do you mean? Aren't these monsters we're fighting the guardians?
Humans only ever see what they want to see. These are mere pawns that the guardian controls.
After saying so, Chevalier tilted her head to the side as if she'd suddenly remembered something.
Come to think of it, I didn't hear the usual shrieks mixed in with the battle cries.
Shikanosuke had vanished without a trace before we could even register it!
...Perhaps he was kidnapped by the guardian.
When? And how!? I didn't notice it at all!
She was contemplating with her hand on her chin.
This was not the first time Shikanosuke had suddenly disappeared, but to think I didn't even realize it until Chevalier brought it up...
Wheeew, another win in the bag! This one was a walk in the park too!
Woah, what's with the serious look there Fuma?
Kirara-senpai returned with a smile. The enemies had all been defeated before I knew it.
Uhh, it looks like Shikanosuke was kidnapped.
Huh? What're you saying?? Shikanosuke-kun? Kidnapped? Huh? Oh no, he is gone!! Huuuuuuuuh!?
Oh my, he's gone again! Shikanosuke-chan, where'd you go!? Shikanosuke-chan!!
Not only Kirara-senpai, but even Hebiko, who was usually paired with Shikanosuke, looked as if she had forgotten about him until just then.
She looked around in a panic and called out his name, but he was nowhere to be found.
Hey, Fuma! How'd he get kidnapped!? Did you just stand there and watch!?
No, it was like, he was already gone when I realized.
When you "realized?!" Aren't you the captain!? Why do you look so calm about this!?
Well, how can I put this, this is like an everyday occurrence for him, so to speak.
Shikanosuke-chan often disappears like this. Only to then come back out while crying later.
Hebiko also seemed surprised, but just like me, she was used to situations like this.
It seems that not only has space been distorted by this magic, but our very perception as well.
To the point that we don't even find it strange if someone just disappeared right before our eyes?
It appears Chevalier also saw only what she wanted to see.
She breathed a sigh with a touch of frustration.
So, what do we do now? I get that disappearing seems to be his special talent and all, but we can't just leave him can we?
Of course not. But, there's not much we can do when we don't even know how he was kidnapped...
Looks like he was taken here.
Annreed suddenly spoke up after she had been examining the dirt a little ways from us.
There's tracks here. He was attacked from behind and dragged this way by someone...
Annreed followed the tracks that were left on the ground and stopped at a corner of the underground ruins.
Annreed examined the floor and the nearby walls again, but eventually seemed to deem it futile.
There's not even a hidden passage here or anything. They probably took off toward the ceiling and disappeared somewhere.
Toward the ceiling!? You mean it can fly?
All I can say for sure is that all the tracks stop here.
Did it really fly off with Shikanosuke in the middle of that battle earlier...?
It was an open feint. A clever farce. The battle must certainly have been a diversion.
Wait, you mean they were aiming for Shikanosuke-kun from the start!?
Or rather, because he was the easiest target.
They're trying to chip away at our combat power. A clever guardian, I'd say.
Realizing that things weren't the same as always, Hebiko's and my expressions hardened.
Perhaps it's a self-repairing type of Guardian. That's why, Chevalier expects he's being kept alive as its "spare parts."
The master of this place is a first-class sorcerer. They must be using a powerful Guardian as a watchdog.
Otherwise, deceiving us while also completing an abduction would be impossible.
Such intelligent Guardians are always the self-repairing type. They have "spare parts" prepared for when they are damaged.
You mean Shikanosuke is living "spare parts" now?
If not, it wouldn't take him. If all it wanted was to reduce our strength, it would have simply killed him here.
As an alchemist, perhaps she could see things from a different perspective than ours, but what she said made sense.
Well, that makes things simple, doesn't it?
We find that Guardian, kick the crap out of it, save Shikanosuke-kun, and we also beat up the sorcerer while we're at it.
That sounds like a plan to me.
Believing that Shikanosuke was still alive, we set our sights on the depths of these underground ruins.
